correctness.rationale: All semigroup elements have interval-layer representations. For k>=K, step-q subintervals cover [0,kt] because (k-q)t>=q-1; lower k representations above Kn transfer to KB. Below Kn<2qn, only a single generator can occur as the positive q-scaled part, giving the exact deleted intervals. The explicit penultimate-layer witness proves uniform optimality. Independent finite dynamic-programming calculations agree in 4650 exhaustive-parameter cases, plus 900 formula cases and 250 sharpness witnesses; the unbounded claim is proved analytically.
